snippet.title: NUTMEG! | Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Reshape English football history in NUTMEG! - launching on Steam in 2026!

Dust off your short shorts, lace up your boots, and don’t you dare shave that moustache – (retro) football is coming (to) home (computers)!

Take a step back in time to manage your favourite teams through twenty years of the beautiful game. 

Start with a Division Four team and take them to the top of the table by setting training schedules and transferring players, answering calls from the press, buying merchandise, and adjusting ticket prices for home games. Combine cards generated from training to develop new tactics and build a deck that even Fergie couldn’t sniff at. 

Then head onto the pitch for fast-paced card battles, diving into the match at key points to ensure the boys do good. Stop an attack or gain control of the ball with a well-played card to shift the odds in your favour and get one in the back of the net. 

Coming to Steam in 2026 from Sumo Sheffield and Secret Mode. Can't wait until then, and want to help our team shape the game? Register your interest in being part of our closed playtest program, to get early access to work-in-progress versions of NUTMEG! 

Wishlist NUTMEG! on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590560/NUTMEG_A_Retro_Football_Management_Game/

Apply for the NUTMEG! VIP Playtest Program: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYa0O-Air3wBeV8BTSL2MAOqBpBKi0pdDrOfHVmE2IbxK_vw/viewform 

Follow Secret Mode: https://linktr.ee/wearesecretmode
Support us directly: https://store.wearesecretmode.com/
